# P4OS HAL. aos_hal_p4.c is the board; aos_hal_stubs.c (generated by
# tools/gen_hal_stubs.py) answers "not available" for whatever is not written
# yet. The platform-free files from AmoledOS join as their block is wired.
#
# WHOLE_ARCHIVE is not optional. The component is a static library, and a
# reference that the stubs' weak definition already satisfies never makes the
# linker pull the member with the real one: aos_ws.c, aos_tcp.c, aos_http.c
# and the rest were silently replaced by their stubs until 2026-09-28.
idf_component_register(
    WHOLE_ARCHIVE
    SRCS "aos_hal_p4.c" "aos_hal_stubs.c" "aos_notif.c" "aos_device_name.c"
         "aos_net_p4.c" "aos_tcp.c" "aos_http.c" "aos_ws.c" "aos_logring.c" "aos_image_p4.c"
         "aos_audio_p4.c" "aos_audio.c" "aos_radio.c" "aos_aac_esp.c"
         "aos_tls.c" "aos_nettools_p4.c"
         "aos_stats.c" "aos_tasks_p4.c"
         "aos_jpeg_p4.c" "aos_h264.c"
         "aos_usb_p4.c" "aos_usb_net_p4.c" "aos_usb_hid_p4.c" "aos_usb_devs_p4.c" "aos_hid_keys.c"
         "aos_retro_p4.c" "aos_lvmem.c" "aos_flashop_p4.c" "aos_worker_p4.c" "aos_ota_p4.c" "aos_coredump_p4.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
    LDFRAGMENTS "psram.lf"
    REQUIRES lvgl esp_timer nvs_flash mbedtls
    PRIV_REQUIRES waveshare__esp32_p4_wifi6_touch_lcd_5 waveshare__esp_lcd_hx8394 espressif__esp_lcd_touch
                  esp_lcd esp_driver_ppa esp_driver_sdmmc sdmmc fatfs esp_mm app_update esp_hw_support
                  esp_wifi esp_netif esp_event lwip espressif__esp_wifi_remote espressif__esp_hosted
                  espressif__mdns
                  esp_driver_jpeg espressif__esp_new_jpeg espressif__libpng espressif__esp_h264
                  esp_driver_i2s espressif__esp_codec_dev espressif__esp_audio_codec
                  esp_driver_tsens bootloader_support spi_flash esp_partition espcoredump
                  espressif__esp_tinyusb json usb
)

# LVGL's objects, styles and layers to PSRAM (aos_lvmem.c): with the C
# library's malloc, every one of them is small enough to land in internal RAM,
# and on the board a home screen and Wi-Fi left 3,8 KB of it (2026-09-28).
target_link_libraries(${COMPONENT_LIB} INTERFACE "-Wl,--wrap=lv_malloc_core" "-Wl,--wrap=lv_realloc_core")
